notes.title: 🚨 Trailer Alert! 🚨
notes.content:
Hello Retropolis Fans!
We have some exciting news to share with you all - Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye is coming soon! We've been hard at work on the sequel to the critically acclaimed VR adventure series and we can't wait for you to experience it.

The new game will continue the story of Philip Log, the hard-boiled robo-detective, and Jenny Montage, the automated femme fatale that just can’t keep herself out of trouble. It will also feature new gameplay mechanics, breathtaking visuals, and an immersive atmosphere of the city.


[previewyoutube=mq3Y6rTTCaE;full][/previewyoutube]

For more details and screenshots visit the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293440/Retropolis_2_Never_Say_Goodbye/] Retropolis 2 Steam page
[/url] And don't forget to wishlist the game like it's hot gold on a sunny day! 

Thank you for your support and we can't wait for you to join the revolution and discover the secrets of Retropolis 2.
Best, 
The Retropolis Team

notes.title: Sequel Announcement and First Screenshot Reveal
notes.content:
Hello Retropols fans!

We are excited to announce that a sequel to The Secret of Retropols is currently in development and will be releasing soon - Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye.

We have been hard at work to bring you even more adventure, mystery, and intrigue in the world of Retropolis. We are pleased to announce that the game will feature substantial improvements in terms of graphics and gameplay length.

To give you a sneak peek of what to expect, here is the first screenshot from Retropolis 2: Never Say Goodbye:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37957281/a89734fe71e3fc46090d38a4b72810bb57c5bea2.png[/img]

We can't wait for you to join us in this new journey, and we hope you'll join us on the Retropolis newsletter to be the first to know about the game's development and release.

Thank you for your support, and see you in Retropolis 2!

Best,
The Secret of Retropols Team

notes.title: Retropolis needs you!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're non-stop working these days. We've read all of your lovely comments and we know how much you guys want a sequel for Retropolis. This is why we work. We cant really say anything right now about what we're doing, since nothing is official yet, but our plan is to make more than just one sequel...  

In the meantime, we need your help - it's for steam players to vote for the games they loved the most this year. Even getting a nomination for the steam awards will be a huge thing for us. So, if you had fun in Retropolis, if you feel a connection to our vision, or if you just want to see more of Retropolis - Please nominate us for the VR category in the Steam Awards. 
It will help us a lot. 

Thanks
The Peanut Button Team

notes.title: We’re gathering feedback
notes.content:
Hey SOR players!

It’s just a blast for us to read all of your supportive reviews of the game, and it what keeps us going. We want to show this game to more players and give you more content to enjoy.  

We are currently gathering all the feedback for things to improve in our upcoming first update for the game. We welcome any feedback, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us! We can't promise we'll be able to implement everything by the next update, but we could always add what you asked for in future Retropolis games. 

With that being said, we want to share that we are currently working on two features for our update: localization for more languages, and smooth turning. These are the two most asked for features so far so that’s what we’re working on. 

If you wish to add your ideas and requests you can do it over our Steam community hub or send an email to peanutbuttonmedia {at} gmail {dot} com

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37957281/cc61f4453a7413aff415c8cbb9ad33291cd96756.gif[/img]

Thanks!
The Peanut Button Team

notes.title: Game is live in one week!
notes.content:
Hi Steam crowd!
Hope you're having a good summer (or winter for our southern-hemisphere friends).

We've just returned from Cannes, France, where The Secret of Retropolis was selected for CannesXR, part of the mythic Cannes Film Festival. This was the world premiere for this game, and so for the first time it was experienced by industry leaders, critics and cinephiles. The reception was overwhelming and we are still trying to keep our cool after all the great talks we had around the game with the festival attendants who played.

So now that we're back home, energized from the interactions we had at Cannes, we're diving back to work. Namely, we're stating to make final preparations for the real deal: 
[b]Launching the game EXACLY ONE WEEK FROM NOW.[/b]

For us, the most important thing is actually getting the game out there to the community, and so we are endlessly excited that you'll get to experience the full story so shortly. We hope this game will add something to the VR world. Since we're self-publishing, we rely on the community to get out the word. Please help us by telling your friends and communities so they don't miss out on this one.

Talk to you very soon,
The Peanut Button team.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37957281/ff726470742c28a71bc6dd1848ced35cc9ba6dd1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37957281/295c44275ac9f07c2feaec2c5976af09a84f86f8.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Our demo will be available until July 21st
notes.content:
Hey everybody.

We want to thank everyone who played the Demo and gave us feedback. It's truly heartwarming to see  players connecting with the style of the game and waiting to see what happens next in the story. For those who didn't play it yet, the demo will be playable until the [b]full game releases on July 21st[/b].

And for those who missed our Steam Next Fest livestreams, we're attaching the recording at the bottom of this announcement. 

There were two issues that were brought to our attention regarding the demo:
1. The mirror in Philip's office is pixelated, and slows down frame rate on lower end machines - we came up with a fix that will be included in the full game.
2. On the knuckles controllers - resting the hand on the grip button prevents interacting at the same time - we're currently working on a revised controller binding that solves this for the demo as well as the full game.

If you're experiencing any other issues, technical or other, let us know in the community hub. :)

Last but not least, we wanted to let you know that [b]tomorrow we'll be posting some major news[/b] about the game's release on July 21st. [url=http://peanut button.net/mailinglist]Join our mailing list[/url] so you don't miss them (and get free Retropolis digital posters).

Take care,
The Peanut Button crew.

notes.title: The Release Date of Retropolis
notes.content:
We've been hard at work to polish all the rough edges around our beloved VR adventure, and after thorough beta-testing we're excited to announce that...

*Suspenseful music*
...
*Drum rolls*
...

notes.title: Play Retropolis before everyone else...
notes.content:
Can’t wait to try out The Secret of Retropolis? We totally get you. After all it IS an awesome game with a fresh perspective on VR… Well, it’s not that long until we release the game (stay tuned for the official release date), but we can tell you there are ways to play the game before anyone else. 

Steam Next ||  June 16-22 

Steam Next is the new branding for the Steam Festival, the amazing event where many upcoming games release their demos for the first time. The Secret of Retropolis will also be participating and will release a demo. You’ll be able to play a part of it for free! Sweet, huh?

If you want to be notified when the demo is out you can join our mailing list > https://www.peanutbutton.net/mailinglist

Cannes XR || July 6 - 17

When we first got the official email we were sure it was some scam… But it was legit, and our VR point-and-click adventure game has been officially selected to premiere at one of the most prestigious film festivals on this Earth. It is truly an honor to have our work presented alongside so many great VR projects. In the festival you’ll be able to play the first part of the game before it’s even out.

More details about the Cannes XR line up here > https://www.marchedufilm.com/programs/cannes-xr/showcases/veer-vr-cinema/

Take care, fellow Steam user,
The Peanut Button Team

notes.title: It's a date!
notes.content:
After a long time of development, we can finally commit to a release date. 
[b]The Secret of Retropolis is coming out in Summer 2021![/b] It's going to be a tough year for any human being, but at least there's something to wait for (if you have a VR headset). 

We also updated our logo, capsule image, and game description. So now it reflects the experience you'll have playing this game.  

If you want to ask anything about the game or see the animation process as it happens - join our Discord! You can use the all-new banner above the description.

See ya there!

notes.title: First Gameplay Video
notes.content:
We know it's been a while since we updated (never).  Lockdowns have been kind of a damper and our initial schedule hit some delays. But we are devs who always look at the bright side of things - The Secret of Retropolis is a game about a city of robots left to themselves after humanity is gone, so for the past year this scenario is more relevant than ever!  (The bright side of COVID-19, right?) 

Soon we will reveal our mysterious launch date (we are gamers ourselves, we know how frustrating delays can be. That's why we are waiting until we're sure our production schedule is solid.) In the meantime we wanted to share with you first gameplay clip, so you'd be exited as we are about this game. It's on the front of our store page, where our future trailer will be. While you're there, hit that Wishlist button if you haven't already. :)

Also we updated the play area to be seated only. We know many VR gamers want to play standing and room-scale, but playtesting proved again and again that The Secret of Retropolis is most fun seated. 

Take care,
See you soon!
